def age_at(born: int, now: int) -> int:
    """Whole years elapsed between birth year born and current year now (now - born). Years only, so the result is 0 when now == born."""
    pre now >= born
    post out >= 0
    post out == now - born
    ex age_at(1990, 2020) == 30
    ex age_at(2000, 2000) == 0
    return now - born
